text:
ben.park: Heads up — EdgeCloud and SkyReserve sent preliminary pricing for Q4. We need a single baseline reserved/spot mix to plug into the cost model. Thoughts?
clara.ortiz: thanks — do we have SKU-level unit prices and the committed-term discounts? i.e. $/GPU-month for 1yr vs 3mo vs on-demand?
diego.ramos: I asked for that. EdgeCloud gave: 1yr=1200, 3mo=1500, spot avg=350 (all $/GPU-month). SkyReserve numbers differ by ~10%.
alice.wong: ok — for modeling let's pick a default split we can vary: reserved 60% (1yr), medium-term 25% (3mo), spot 15%. that keeps latency SLAs on top. open to pushback.
eva.chen: supply reality: EdgeCloud flags a seasonal dip Oct->Nov where spot availability drops ~30% and preemptions up. if we lock 60% reserved that should protect throughput.
ben.park: @clara @diego want the blended unit cost and an amortized committed price per-token for the pricing workstream. can someone run quick calc? sample formula: `blended = r*price_1yr + m*price_3mo + s*price_spot`
diego.ramos: quick paste (assumes 60/25/15):
```
# GPU-month blended price
price_1yr=1200
price_3mo=1500
price_spot=350
blended = 0.60*price_1yr + 0.25*price_3mo + 0.15*price_spot
# blended = $ (0.6*1200 + 0.25*1500 + 0.15*350) = $ (720 + 375 + 52.5) = $1147.5 / GPU-month
```
clara.ortiz: good. next step: convert GPU-month -> tokens. use baseline throughput = 500M tokens / GPU-month for our medium seq workloads. that yields ~$0.002295 per 1k tokens (approx).
alice.wong: can we run two more scenarios: (A) conservative spot (10%) (B) aggressive spot (30%) so product can show price banding in the SOW?
ben.park: yes — Ben will own collecting final CSVs from both partners (SKU, committed months, price, max qps, region) and push into the cost model. target: get data by EOD Thu. @eva.chen will validate availability windows.
eva.chen: noted — I'll also flag any blackout windows for on-prem migrations.
supply_bot: Automated reminder: please attach CSVs to this thread or to the Partnerships drive folder /partnerships/marketplace-inputs.
clara.ortiz: action items: 1) ben.park collect SKUs (due Thu) 2) diego.ramos run scenarios A/B/C (due Fri) 3) eva.chen confirm supply windows (due Thu) 4) alice.wong produce pricing band doc (due Mon)
ben.park: thanks all — will follow up with CSV links. :thumbsup:
